name: rosetta-call-a-function
code:
use default

greeting() -> string => "no arguments"

add(left: int, right: int) -> int => left + right

announce(what: string) is
    write_line("statement context: {what}")
si

write_line(greeting())
write_line("fixed arguments: {add(2, 3)}")

announce("the return value is discarded")

let operation = add

write_line("first class: {operation(4, 5)}")
write_line("threaded first argument: {6 |> add(7)}")

let add_ten = (value: int) => add(10, value)

if int.try_parse("42", parsed ref) then
    write_line("written through a ref argument: {parsed}")

write_line("there are no optional, named or variadic arguments")

use default

greeting() -> string => "no arguments"

add(left: int, right: int) -> int => left + right

announce(what: string) is
    write_line("statement context: {what}")
si

write_line(greeting())
write_line("fixed arguments: {add(2, 3)}")

announce("the return value is discarded")

let operation = add

write_line("first class: {operation(4, 5)}")
write_line("threaded first argument: {6 |> add(7)}")

let add_ten = (value: int) => add(10, value)

write_line("partial application: {add_ten(1)}")

let parsed mut = 0

if int.try_parse("42", parsed ref) then
    write_line("written through a ref argument: {parsed}")
fi

write_line("there are no optional, named or variadic arguments")
